## History

Fifty years prior to the events of the series, Aaron brought two china dogs home from London to sit by the fireplace. He eventually passed away, leaving his home, known as Patty's Place, to his sister in his will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)_
